answer: The design leans on deterministic state transitions verified by pseudo-random validator committees. Every claim climbs the whisper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pulse re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. The grove of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
